boundaries.memory: Agents may read scoped context and persist bounded local audit/state autonomously; user-authored or personal memory requires ASK and explicit approval.
boundaries.mcpA2a: Connections and outbound messages require ASK; secrets and safety bypasses are NEVER.
boundaries.controlLoop: The loop may plan, mutate through local governed adapters, and validate autonomously; ASK is reserved for external effects or user-owned memory, and NEVER actions are refused.
boundaries.infrastructure: CTXRoute routes context, Archify provides architecture evidence, and Sensor provides static safety diagnostics.
